name: Relax With Bird
summary:
This is a digital pet application to heal your heart.

No need to worry about taking care of this bird.
During your break, just watch the wild birds rest their wings.
Your heart will be at peace before you are aware of it.

How do you usually spend your breaks?
Enjoy surfing the web or watching some videos?
The bird sits quietly by your side while you surf the web or watch videos without any interruptions.
In its presence, you will be healed.
 
The bird is very attached to you.
